{{Top|leg}}
'''Grand Consort''' or '''Lord Consort''' was the title held by the wife or the husband of a [[Grand Lord]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. [[Nida Korsin's consort]] and [[Iliana Hilts]] held the title in their respective times.

To prevent any treachery between spouses and according to the law of the Tribe when a Grand Lord died his consort was executed.
